turns.q: If it doesn't work out for me, what are my options?
turns.replyTail:
ncel
Message from Smile Concierge: If your teeth are not tracking as expected, your doctor may recommend additional aligners called refinements. This usually involves updated records so the treatment plan can be adjusted based on your progress. Whether refinements are included or involve an additional cost depends on your dental office and treatment plan. If you notice your teeth shifting after treatment, a dental professional can evaluate you and may recommend new aligners or updated retainers.
